李月芽走进宿舍楼，直到确认吴姜的视线彻底看不到自己，脚步立刻加快，几乎是一路小跑着往楼上冲去。

刚冲进宿舍门，她就被三个舍友团团围了起来，一个个挤眉弄眼，眼神里满是调侃。

舍长王萌率先凑上前，轻轻戳了戳她的胳膊，笑着打趣：“哟，我们家芽芽可算回来了！刚才急急忙忙跑出去干嘛呢？我们可都看见了，你出门前还偷偷化妆了，老实交代，是不是下去见男朋友啦？”

“就是就是！”舍友林晓丽连忙凑过来附和，语气里满是八卦，“快说，你去见谁了，我们见过没有？”

李月芽的脸颊瞬间染上一层淡淡的红晕，像熟透的桃子。

她连忙摆了摆手，故作镇定地反驳，语气却带着几分不易察觉的慌乱：“什么男朋友啊，你们可别瞎猜！就是家里人托人给我送点东西，我下去拿一下而已。”

说着，她飞快地将手里的袋子放在自己的书桌前，此刻，不敢直视舍友们的目光。

其实刚才出门前，她确实偷偷对着镜子化了个浅妆，就是怕舍友们八卦，还特意躲在卫生间偷偷弄的，没想到还是被看见了。

“切，我们才不信呢。”舍友们异口同声地撇了撇嘴，只是眼神依旧带着调侃。

李月芽生怕再被缠问下去露了馅，连忙抓起桌上的钥匙，含糊地说了一句“我还有事，先下去了”，就急匆匆地冲出了宿舍，连耳根都红透了。

跑到宿舍楼下，她特意停住脚步，抬手摸了摸自己发烫的脸颊，又对着墙壁深呼吸了几下，等感觉脸上的温度降下来、神色恢复自然后，才慢悠悠地往外走。

楼下，吴姜正靠在车身上刷手机，见她走过来，忍不住挑眉吐槽，语气里满是嫌弃：“你可真能磨蹭，你这放东西的功夫，都够我吃一碗面了。”

李月芽一听这话，瞬间炸毛，瞪着他说道：“等我一下怎么了？想等本姑娘的多了去了，让你等，那是你的荣幸！赶紧开车，今天非得吃穷你不可！”

吴姜嗤笑一声，拉开车门坐进驾驶座：“行行行，我们李大小姐最美了。说吧，想去吃什么？”

Li Yueya walked into the dormitory building, and until she confirmed that Wu Jiang could not see her at all, she immediately quickened her steps and rushed upstairs almost at a trot.

As soon as she burst into the dormitory door, she was surrounded by three roommates, each of them winking and their eyes were full of ridicule.

Wang Meng, the head of the dormitory, was the first to come forward, gently poked her arm, and joked with a smile: "Hey, our Yaya is back! Why did you run out in a hurry just now? We all saw it. You secretly put on makeup before going out. Tell me honestly, did you go down to meet your boyfriend?"

"That's right!" Roommate Lin Xiaoli quickly came over to agree, her tone full of gossip, "Quickly tell me, who are you going to see? Have we met before?"

Li Yueya's cheeks were instantly stained with a faint blush, like a ripe peach.

She quickly waved her hand and retorted calmly, but her tone was a bit unnoticeable: "Who is your boyfriend? Don't make blind guesses! It's just that my family asked someone to give me something, I just went down to get it."

As she said that, she quickly put the bag in her hand in front of her desk. At this moment, she did not dare to look directly into the eyes of her roommates.

In fact, before going out just now, she did secretly put on light makeup in front of the mirror. She was afraid that her roommates would gossip, so she hid in the bathroom to do it secretly, but she didn't expect to be seen.

"Tch, we don't believe it." The roommates curled their lips in unison, but their eyes were still teasing.

Li Yueya was afraid that she would be questioned again and her secret would be revealed, so she quickly grabbed the keys on the table, said vaguely, "I have something else to do, I'll go down first," and hurried out of the dormitory, even the roots of her ears were red.

When she ran downstairs to the dormitory, she stopped deliberately, raised her hand to touch her hot cheek, and took a few deep breaths against the wall. After she felt the temperature on her face cool down and her expression returned to normal, she walked out slowly.

Downstairs, Wu Jiang was leaning on the car while scrolling through his cell phone. When he saw her approaching, he couldn't help raising his eyebrows and complaining, his tone full of disgust: "You are really lazy. The time you put things in is enough for me to eat a bowl of noodles."

When Li Yueya heard this, she immediately became furious and glared at him and said, "What's wrong with waiting for me? I've been waiting for you so much. It's your honor to let you wait! Drive quickly, you must be poor today!"

Wu Jiang sneered, opened the car door and got into the driver's seat: "Okay, okay, our Miss Li is the most beautiful. Tell me, what do you want to eat?"
